caption: The drawing on a beige background depicts two identical small house-shaped objects positioned within a lightly sketched rectangular frame. The houses are rendered in a combination of red, black, and shades of gray. Both houses feature red gabled roofs with a checkered pattern indicating roof tiles, red chimneys on top, and red doors with surrounding trim on the front facades. Each house has two windows on the upper floor and two on the ground floor, with red frames. The bodies of the houses are shaded in dark gray or black with some light highlights to suggest dimensionality. The house on the left is positioned lower and slightly to the left of the house on the right. In the upper right corner, there is a small hand-written note that reads "Build up #1." The composition is sparse, focusing attention on the two objects within the outlined rectangular area.
title: House Coin Bank
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
